def test_user_addresses_and_cards():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    user_data = {"username": username, "password": "pwd", "email": "a@b.com", "firstName": "A", "lastName": "B"}
    requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_data, timeout=10)

    addr_data = {"city": "City", "country": "Country", "number": "12", "postcode": "12345", "street": "Street", "userID": username}
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=addr_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addr_id = resp.json().get("id")

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/addresses/{addr_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("city") == "City"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/addresses"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addrs = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("address", [])
    assert any(a.get("id") == addr_id for a in addrs)

    card_data = {"ccv": "123", "expires": "12/25", "longNum": "1234567890123456", "userID": username}
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_id = resp.json().get("id")

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/cards/{card_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("expires") == "12/25"
    assert "*" in resp.json().get("longNum", "")

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/cards"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cards = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("card", [])
    assert any(c.get("id") == card_id for c in cards)

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/addresses/{addr_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/addresses"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addrs = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("address", [])
    assert not any(a.get("id") == addr_id for a in addrs)

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/cards/{card_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/cards"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cards = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("card", [])
    assert not any(c.get("id") == card_id for c in cards)

def test_carts_management():
    customer_id = f"cust_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    item_id = "item_1"
    item_data = {"itemId": item_id, "quantity": 2, "unitPrice": 9.99}

    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=item_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) == 1
    assert items[0]["itemId"] == item_id
    assert items[0]["quantity"] == 2

    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=item_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["quantity"] == 4

    patch_data = {"itemId": item_id, "quantity": 10, "unitPrice": 9.99}
    resp = requests.patch(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=patch_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["quantity"] == 10

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_catalogue_retrieval():
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    socks = resp.json()
    assert isinstance(socks, list)

    if socks:
        sock_id = socks[0]["id"]
        resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue/{sock_id}"), timeout=10)
        assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
        assert resp.json()["id"] == sock_id

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue/invalid_id_12345"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/tags"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert "tags" in resp.json()

def test_user_registration_and_login():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    password = "password123"
    user_data = {
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }

    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    customer = resp.json()
    assert customer.get("username") == username
    assert customer.get("firstName") == "Test"
    assert customer.get("lastName") == "User"
    assert "password" not in customer

    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_data, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 409, f"Expected 409, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, password), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, "wrong"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 401, f"Expected 401, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("status") is True

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    customer_deleted = resp.json()
    assert "firstName" not in customer_deleted or not customer_deleted["firstName"]

def test_payments_workflow():
    order_id = f"order_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    payment_req = {
        "address": {"city": "C", "country": "C", "number": "1", "postcode": "1", "street": "S"},
        "amount": 50.0,
        "card": {"ccv": "123", "expires": "12/25", "longNum": "1234567890123456"},
        "customer": {"firstName": "A", "lastName": "B"},
        "orderId": order_id
    }

    resp = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_req, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auth = resp.json()
    assert auth["authorised"] is True
    assert auth["orderId"] == order_id

    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auths = resp.json()
    assert len(auths) == 1
    assert auths[0]["authorised"] is True

    payment_req["amount"] = 150.0
    resp = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_req, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["authorised"] is False

    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auths = resp.json()
    assert len(auths) == 2
    assert auths[1]["authorised"] is False
